title: Profile upload to Medtronic error when having too many rows in basals
symptom: After a profile change, the profile was not uploaded to the pump with a noisy alarm. The user found that the profile was too big (added few rows to basals) and recovered by reducing the number of rows in basals to 8.
cause: The thread suggests the issue may be a limitation of the pump or OrangeLink, or a communication problem with the RileyLink clone causing timeouts during the long command transmission.
fix: The user recovered by reducing the number of rows in basals to 8. The maintainer suggests that the problem might be with the connection, as sending basals requires a long command sent in 3 parts, and if the RileyLink clone has communication problems, it may fail.
evidence_quote: I found out that I have made the profile too big (added few rows to basals) and managed to recover by reducing number of rows in basals to 8.
